parameters.jsCode:
const saved = $('5. Preserve Data + Extract Video ID').first().json;
return { json: { record_id: saved.record_id, heygen_video_id: saved.heygen_video_id, content_type: saved.content_type, platform: saved.platform } };

const saved = $('5f. Restore HeyGen Context').first().json;
return { json: { record_id: saved.record_id, heygen_video_id: saved.heygen_video_id, content_type: saved.content_type, platform: saved.platform } };

nodes.name: 3g. Re-read Record Live
nodes.notes: HG-2: reads the record again right before submit. The Ready list fetched at the start of the run can be stale.

nodes.name: 3h. Count Today's Submits
nodes.notes: HG-2: records locked or submitted to HeyGen today (PHT). Counted against the daily cap.

nodes.name: 3i. Gate - Live State + Daily Cap
nodes.notes: HG-2: submit only if the record is still Ready for Video Generation with an empty HeyGen_Video_ID and the daily cap is not reached. DAILY_VIDEO_CAP lives here.

nodes.name: 3j. Gate Route
nodes.notes: 0 = submit, 1 = daily cap reached (write note, stay Ready), 2 = skip (nothing written)

nodes.name: 3k. Lock Record (Video Processing)
nodes.notes: HG-2: the lock. Status leaves Ready BEFORE the HeyGen call so no other run can pick the record up. If this write fails the run stops and nothing is submitted.

parameters.jsCode:
const g = $('3i. Gate - Live State + Daily Cap').first().json;
return [{ json: { ...g } }];

nodes.name: 3m. Cap Reached - Write Note
nodes.notes: HG-2: over the daily cap. Status is left at Ready for Video Generation; only the note is written.

nodes.name: 5a. Submit OK?
nodes.notes: HG-2: false = HeyGen returned no video_id. Never write an empty ID on Video Processing.

nodes.name: 4x. Error - HeyGen Submit Failed
nodes.notes: HG-2: submit returned no video_id. Status = Failed with the HeyGen error in Reel_Notes. A Failed record with no HeyGen ID does not count against the daily cap.

nodes.name: 3n. Not Approved - Back to Verified
nodes.notes: T-44: Production_Approval not ticked or Script_Approval not Approved. Nothing is sent to HeyGen; Status returns to Verified so the record is not picked up again.
